summary: StudentTrainingPrograms manages a student's connection to training programs, including creation, update, inactivation/reactivation, and retrieval. It supports edit and read-only modes, tracks comments, includes validation, and allows selection of associated agencies, programs, and stages.
purpose: To track and administer which training programs a student is assigned to, including program details, stage, agency, timeframe (start/end dates), status (active/inactive), and comments. Allows for management via add, edit, delete (inactivate), and reactivate operations, and provides interfaces for data entry, display, and validation.

workflows.name: Add Student Training Program
steps: Validate required fields and date order

workflows.name: Edit Student Training Program
steps: Modify fields (program, stage, agency, dates, comments)

business_rules: Inactive flag marks records as deleted/reactivated
Dropdowns for Program, Stage, and Agency must be populated from reference data
Only editable screens allow add/edit/delete/reactivate actions
conditions: If UserSession is null, cancel data operations
ScreenIsEditable controls access to edit functions
system_behavior: Grid displays, adds, edits, deletes, and reactivates entries
Redirect after operations to reflect changes
JavaScript setup for field validation and client scripting
dependencies: Agency, Program, Stage reference data required
Stored procedures: StudentDetailsTrainingProgramAdd, Update, Inactivate, Search
exceptions: Data operation cancelled if UserSession is null
